payload.body: world { read: "leave-mark" } (bare) sorts a household's marks into drafts, docket (pending), published, backed and refused. A claim the candle has locked but no settlement has carried, or one in held_review, is on none of them, so it vanishes from its owner's list until it publishes. kogane/the-swallets locked at candle 247 (18:00Z 10-13) and was carried the next morning: most of a day missing. world.mjs's own comment above drafts/docket warns these states need a shelf. Expected: a 'locked, awaiting settlement' shelf (and held_review), with its receipt.
payload.title: My-marks read has no shelf for a locked or held claim

fields.steps: 1. Stake a mark so it goes on the docket. 2. After the candle locks it (claim-locked in household read: outcomes) and before the settlement carries it, run world { read: "leave-mark" } bare: the mark is in none of drafts, docket, published, backed or refused. 3. world { read: "leave-mark", args: { mark } } on the same id still shows it, so only the list loses it.
